'''Level 22''' was a level of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the era of the New Republic, Skydove Freight&mdash;a shipping concern owned by the Anjiliac kajidic&mdash;operated the [[Hangar/Legends|docking facility]] [[landing dock Q2214 GRB]] on level 22.<ref name="Scourge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Level 22 was first mentioned in [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], a [[2012]] novel by [[Jeff Grubb]] and adaptation of the [[2002]] roleplaying adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]''. The novel noted that landing dock Q2114 GRB,<ref name="Scourge" /> a location that appeared in ''Tempest Feud'',<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> was situated on level 22,<ref name="Scourge" /> thereby retrospectively establishing ''Tempest Feud'' as level 22's first appearance.<ref name="TF" />
